description: This bar chart illustrates Shapley values for four different models – mBERT, XLM-R, XLM, and chLSTM – across seven linguistic probes labeled L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The horizontal axis represents the linguistic probes, listed in the order L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, while the vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each probe, there is a grouped set of four bars, one for each model, distinguished by color: mBERT is light gray, XLM-R is medium blue, XLM is dark blue, and chLSTM is light green. The shortest bar is for mBERT at L₄⁺, with a value of approximately 2, while the tallest bar is for XLM-R at T, reaching a value of approximately 72. Generally, the bars for XLM-R and chLSTM are taller than those for mBERT and XLM across most probes. No bars are visually emphasized, and the grouping is arranged such that bars for each model are adjacent for each probe.
